trajectory_behavior.description: Use one continuous smooth trajectory instead of separate point-to-point connectors.

path_style.description: The path should read as one flowing semantic trajectory through space.

update_rule.description: When a new point appears, extend and update the existing trajectory as a single continuous path rather than drawing an isolated new segment.

z_axis_feel.description: The trajectory should feel like it gently extends forward along the z-axis as time progresses.

geometry.description: Render the trajectory as a thin volumetric 3D tube.

visual_style.description: The trajectory should remain visually elegant, soft, and lighter than the points.

trajectory_behavior.design_intent: The line should feel like a living, continuous conversation trace evolving through semantic space over time.
